intro: The Atlanta Table invites warmth and togetherness. Its rounded edges keep family moments safe, while the durable wood construction ensures lasting beauty for gatherings, big or small.

features.title: Solid rubberwood frame
features.text: Crafted from premium rubberwood, this table offers durability, strength, and lasting elegance for your home.

features.title: Safe rounded corners
features.text: Safety and style, all in one. Smooth, rounded corners make it family-friendly—perfect for homes with children.

features.title: Streamlined modern design
features.text: Elevate your space instantly—the contemporary design adds sleek sophistication to any dining room.

features.title: Spacious seating for six
features.text: Make room for everyone—this table comfortably seats six, making it ideal for family dinners and celebrations.

features.title: Smooth, stain-resistant finish
features.text: The natural finish isn’t just stylish—it’s stain-resistant, making cleanup quick and keeping your table looking fresh.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
